sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: strong all-round legume profile. Fibre, minerals, and useful protein all show up well enough to make it a very solid category food. Easy to use across lots of meals. Works in bowls, curries, salads, hummus, and snacks. Pretty filling and steady. Useful as a practical staple rather than just a niche health food.
